SELECT  DISTINCT
    [inspection_id],
    [inspection_introduction],
    [inspection_preamble],
    [inspection_closing],
    [officer_notes]
FROM 
    [stg].[nris_inspection]
WHERE 
    ISNULL([inspection_introduction], '') <> '' 
    OR ISNULL([inspection_preamble], '') <> '' 
    OR ISNULL([inspection_closing], '') <> '' 
    OR ISNULL([officer_notes], '') <> '';

SELECT DISTINCT 
    [assessment_sub_type],
    CHECKSUM([assessment_sub_type]) AS assessment_sub_type_hash
FROM 
    [stg].[nris_Inspection]

SELECT DISTINCT
REPLACE([inspection_auth_type],'Sand & Gravel', 'SAND AND GRAVEL') AS InspectionAuthType
--,CHECKSUM([inspection_auth_type]) AS inspection_auth_type_hash
FROM [stg].[nris_Inspection]
where ISNULL([inspection_auth_type],'')<>''

SELECT DISTINCT
      inspection_auth_status
      ,CHECKSUM(inspection_auth_status) AS inspection_auth_status_hash
  FROM [stg].[nris_Inspection]
  where ISNULL(inspection_auth_status,'')<>''

SELECT [Incident_Type_Code],  CHECKSUM([Incident_Type_Code]) AS Incident_Type_Code_hash
FROM
(
select DISTINCT [followup_investigation_type_code] AS [Incident_Type_Code] FROM [stg].[public_mine_incident] WHERE ISNULL([followup_investigation_type_code],'')<>''
UNION
select  [determination_type_code] AS [Incident_Type_Code] FROM [stg].[public_mine_incident] WHERE ISNULL([determination_type_code],'')<>''
UNION
select  [mine_determination_type_code] AS [Incident_Type_Code] FROM [stg].[public_mine_incident] WHERE ISNULL([mine_determination_type_code],'')<>''
) U

SELECT DISTINCT 
[mine_incident_id]
,[reported_by_name]
,[reported_by_phone_no]
,[reported_by_phone_ext]
,[reported_by_email]
,[verbal_notification_provided]
,[verbal_notification_timestamp]
,[reported_to_inspector_contact_method]
,[reported_to_inspector_contacted]
,[emergency_services_called]
FROM [stg].[public_mine_incident]

SELECT DISTINCT 
      [incident_location]
      ,CHECKSUM([incident_location]) as [incident_location_hash]
FROM [stg].[public_mine_incident]
WHERE ISNULL([incident_location],'')<>''

SELECT  
[mine_incident_id]
,incident_description
FROM [stg].[public_mine_incident]
WHERE ISNULL(incident_description,'')<>''

SELECT 
[mine_incident_id]
,[johsc_worker_rep_name]
,[johsc_worker_rep_contacted]
,[johsc_management_rep_name]
,[johsc_management_rep_contacted]
,[johsc_worker_rep_contact_method]
,[johsc_worker_rep_contact_timestamp]
,[johsc_management_rep_contact_method]
,[johsc_management_rep_contact_timestamp]
FROM [stg].[public_mine_incident]
WHERE
[johsc_worker_rep_name] IS NOT NULL
OR [johsc_worker_rep_contacted] IS NOT NULL
OR [johsc_management_rep_name] IS NOT NULL
OR [johsc_management_rep_contacted] IS NOT NULL
OR [johsc_worker_rep_contact_method] IS NOT NULL
OR [johsc_worker_rep_contact_timestamp] IS NOT NULL
OR [johsc_management_rep_contact_method] IS NOT NULL
OR [johsc_management_rep_contact_timestamp] IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT
[mine_guid]
,[mine_name]
,[mine_number]
,[mine_latitude]
,[mine_longitude]
,[government_agency_type_code]
,[government_agency_type_d]
,[mine_exemption_fee_status_note]
,[mine_exemption_fee_status_code]
,[mine_exemption_fee_status_d]
,[operation_status]
,[operation_status_code]
,[mine_operation_status_code]
,[mine_operation_status_reason_code]
,[mine_operation_status_sub_reason_code]
,[mine_operation_status_d]
,[mine_operation_status_reason_d]
,[mine_operation_status_sub_reason_d]
,[mine_date]
,[status_date]
,[mine_tenure]
,[mine_tenure_type_code]
,[mine_commodity]
,[mine_commodity_type_code]
,[mine_disturbance]
,[mine_disturbance_type_code]
,[mine_region]
,[major_mine_ind]
,[bcmi_url]
,[major_mine_d]
FROM [stg].[public_mine_summary_view]

SELECT 
permit_id,
    MAX(permit_guid) AS permit_guid, 
    MAX(permit_no) AS permit_no,
    MAX(permit_tenure) AS permit_tenure,
    MAX(permit_tenure_type_code) AS permit_tenure_type_code,
    MAX(permit_commodity) AS permit_commodity,
    MAX(permit_commodity_type_code) AS permit_commodity_type_code,
    MAX(permit_disturbance) AS permit_disturbance,
    MAX(permit_disturbance_type_code) AS permit_disturbance_type_code,
    MAX(permit_status_code) AS permit_status_code,
    MAX(permit_status_changed_timestamp) AS permit_status_changed_timestamp,
    MAX(permit_exemption_fee_status_code) AS permit_exemption_fee_status_code,
    MAX(permit_exemption_fee_status_d) AS permit_exemption_fee_status_d,
    MAX(permit_exemption_fee_status_note) AS permit_exemption_fee_status_note,
    MAX(permittee_party_guid) AS permittee_party_guid,
    MAX(permittee_first_name) AS permittee_first_name,
    MAX(permittee_name) AS permittee_name,
    MAX(permittee_address_suite) AS permittee_address_suite,
    MAX(permittee_address_line_1) AS permittee_address_line_1,
    MAX(permittee_address_line_2) AS permittee_address_line_2,
    MAX(permittee_address_city) AS permittee_address_city,
    MAX(permittee_address_post_code) AS permittee_address_post_code,
    MAX(permittee_address_prov) AS permittee_address_prov
FROM
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        permit_id, 
        permit_guid, 
        permit_no,
        permit_tenure,
        permit_tenure_type_code,
        permit_commodity,
        permit_commodity_type_code,
        permit_disturbance,
        permit_disturbance_type_code,
        permit_status_code,
        permit_status_changed_timestamp,
        permit_exemption_fee_status_code,
        permit_exemption_fee_status_d,
        permit_exemption_fee_status_note,
        permittee_party_guid,
        permittee_first_name,
        permittee_name,
        permittee_address_suite,
        permittee_address_line_1,
        permittee_address_line_2,
        permittee_address_city,
        permittee_address_post_code,
        permittee_address_prov
    FROM [stg].[public_mine_summary_view] 
    WHERE permit_id is not null
) s
GROUP BY permit_id;

-- SELECT for DimOrderStopDetail
SELECT DISTINCT
    LTRIM(RTRIM(detail)) AS Detail,
    LTRIM(RTRIM(observation)) AS Observation,
    LTRIM(RTRIM(response)) AS Response,
    CHECKSUM(LTRIM(RTRIM(detail)), LTRIM(RTRIM(observation)), LTRIM(RTRIM(response))) AS Detail_Observation_Response_Hash
FROM [stg].[nris_order_stop_detail]
WHERE ISNULL(detail, '') <> '' OR ISNULL(observation, '') <> '' OR ISNULL(response, '') <> '';

-- SELECT for DimOrderStopType
SELECT DISTINCT
    LTRIM(RTRIM(stop_type)) AS StopType,
    CHECKSUM(LTRIM(RTRIM(stop_type))) AS StopType_Hash
FROM [stg].[nris_order_stop_detail]
WHERE ISNULL(stop_type, '') <> ''

-- SELECT for DimOrderStopAuthorityActSection
SELECT DISTINCT
    LTRIM(RTRIM(authority_act_section)) AS AuthorityActSection,
    CHECKSUM(LTRIM(RTRIM(authority_act_section))) AS AuthorityActSection_Hash
FROM [stg].[nris_order_stop_detail]
WHERE ISNULL(authority_act_section, '') <> '';

-- SELECT for DimOrderStopStatus
SELECT DISTINCT
    LTRIM(RTRIM(stop_status)) AS StopStatus,
    CHECKSUM(LTRIM(RTRIM(stop_status))) AS StopStatus_Hash
FROM [stg].[nris_order_stop_detail]
WHERE ISNULL(stop_status, '') <> '';

-- SELECT for DimOrderStopResponseStatus
SELECT DISTINCT
    LTRIM(RTRIM(response_status)) AS ResponseStatus,
    CHECKSUM(LTRIM(RTRIM(response_status))) AS ResponseStatus_Hash
FROM [stg].[nris_order_stop_detail]
WHERE ISNULL(response_status, '') <> '';

-- SELECT for DimOrderStopAuthorityAct
SELECT DISTINCT
    LTRIM(RTRIM(authority_act)) AS AuthorityAct,
    CHECKSUM(LTRIM(RTRIM(authority_act))) AS AuthorityAct_Hash
FROM [stg].[nris_order_stop_detail]
WHERE ISNULL(authority_act, '') <> '';

SELECT DISTINCT
     type_of_application AS ApplicationType,
    CHECKSUM(LTRIM(RTRIM(type_of_application))) AS ApplicationType_Hash
FROM [stg].[public_now_application]
WHERE ISNULL(type_of_application, '') <> '';

SELECT DISTINCT
     notice_of_work_type_code AS NoticeOfWorkTypeCode,
    CHECKSUM(LTRIM(RTRIM(notice_of_work_type_code))) AS NoticeOfWorkTypeCode_Hash
FROM [stg].[public_now_application]
WHERE ISNULL(notice_of_work_type_code, '') <> '';

SELECT DISTINCT [now_application_status_code]
      ,[description]
      ,[active_ind]
      ,[create_timestamp]
      ,[update_timestamp]
      ,[display_order]
  FROM [stg].[public_now_application_status]

select  DISTINCT
security_not_required_reason AS Reason,
CHECKSUM(LTRIM(RTRIM(security_not_required_reason))) AS Reason_Hash
from stg.public_now_application
WHERE ISNULL(security_not_required_reason, '') <> '';

SELECT DISTINCT 
LTRIM(RTRIM([inspection_auth_source_id])) AS InspectionAuthSource
FROM [stg].[nris_Inspection]
WHERE ISNULL(inspection_auth_source_id,'')<>''

SELECT DISTINCT 
[mine_incident_category_code]
,[description]
,[parent_mine_incident_category_code]
,display_order
FROM [stg].[public_mine_incident_category]

SELECT  DISTINCT
--[mine_incident_id]
LTRIM(RTRIM(injuries_description)) AS injuries_description
--CHECKSUM(LTRIM(RTRIM(injuries_description))) AS injuries_description_hash
FROM [stg].[public_mine_incident]
WHERE ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(injuries_description)),'')<>'' and UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(injuries_description)))<>'UNKNOWN'

SELECT DISTINCT ltrim(rtrim(mine_region)) AS MineRegion
  FROM [stg].[public_mine_summary_view]
  WHERE isnull(ltrim(rtrim(mine_region)),'')<>''

select 
i.mine_incident_id, 
i.compliance_article_id, 
A.article_act_code, 
A.section,
A.sub_section, 
A.paragraph, 
A.sub_paragraph, 
A.description,
A.long_description, 
A.effective_date, 
A.expiry_date
from  [stg].[public_mine_incident_do_subparagraph] i
LEFT JOIN [stg].[public_compliance_article] A ON i.compliance_article_id=A.compliance_article_id
ORDER BY 
i.mine_incident_id, 
i.compliance_article_id

select 
now_application_delay_id, 
delay_type_code, 
start_comment, 
start_date, 
end_comment,
end_date 
from [stg].[public_now_application_delay]

SELECT DISTINCT
order_stop_detail_id,
section_number     AS SectionNumber,
section_title      AS SectionTitle,
section_text       AS SectionText
FROM [stg].[nris_noncompliance_permit]

SELECT DISTINCT
    nc.noncompliance_legislation_id,
    nc.order_stop_detail_id,
    nc.estimated_incident_date,
    nc.noncompliant_description,
    nc.parent_act_id,
    nc.legislation_act_section_id,
    las.section AS section,
    nc.compliance_article_id,
    lca.comments AS article_comments
FROM [stg].[nris_noncompliance_legislation] nc
LEFT JOIN [stg].[nris_legislation_act_section] las
    ON nc.legislation_act_section_id = las.legislation_act_section_id
LEFT JOIN [stg].[nris_legislation_compliance_article] lca
    ON nc.compliance_article_id = lca.legislation_compliance_article_id
	order by order_stop_detail_id

SELECT 
[inspected_location_id]
,[DetailType]
,[detail]
,[Response]
,[RespondDate]
,[SourceRowID]
 FROM [stg].[v_DimInspectedLocationDetail]

SELECT DISTINCT
    loc.location_id,
    ISNULL(il.inspection_id, -1)                          AS inspection_id,   -- default unknown
    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(loc.description)), '')             AS LocationDescription,
    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(loc.notes)), '')                   AS LocationNotes,
    TRY_CONVERT(float,  NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(loc.latitude)),  ''))  AS latitude,
    TRY_CONVERT(float,  NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(loc.longitude)), ''))  AS longitude,
    TRY_CONVERT(float,  NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(loc.utm_easting)), ''))   AS utm_easting,
    TRY_CONVERT(float,  NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(loc.utm_northing)), ''))  AS utm_northing,
    TRY_CONVERT(int,    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(loc.zone_number)), ''))   AS zone_number,
    LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(loc.zone_letter)), 1)                AS zone_letter,
    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ilt.inspected_location_type)), '') AS InspectedLocationType
FROM [stg].[nris_location]               loc
LEFT JOIN [stg].[nris_inspected_location]       il  ON il.location_id = loc.location_id
LEFT JOIN [stg].[nris_inspected_location_type]  ilt ON ilt.inspected_location_type_id = il.inspected_location_type_id;
